entities.summary: Nicholas Hilmy Kyrgios, nicknamed "Kygs", is an Australian professional tennis player. Kyrgios currently ranks 741 in the ATP and has been ranked as high as world No. 13 in singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP), achieved on 24 October 2016. He has won seven ATP Tour singles titles, including the 2019 and 2022 Washington Open, and reached eleven finals, most notably a major final at the 2022 Wimbledon Championships. In doubles, Kyrgios has a career-high ranking of world No. 11, achieved on 7 November 2022, winning a major doubles title at the 2022 Australian Open while partnering with Thanasi Kokkinakis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Kyrgios has won seven ATP Tour singles titles and reached eleven finals, including a major final at Wimbledon. His career-high ranking of world No. 13 in singles by the ATP has had a significant impact on Australian tennis.
